scenarios.purpose: Original game baseline without the Mod.
steps: Lock a legal game build, platform/Proton client and an isolated test prefix.
Launch the game without the Mod.
Observe the main menu using independent evidence.
Open settings and return without changing settings.
Do not load the daily save.

scenarios.purpose: One placeholder character through native event, save, cross-process restart, two slots and vanilla load after disabling the Mod.
steps: Pass the exact candidate package through the real scanner/load path.
Create a new isolated test save.
Make the placeholder character appear as an independent identity and reach the counter.
Observe a native trade event and its state.
Quit the process and restart with the same save.
Verify a second slot does not receive the first slot's state.
Disable the Mod only on the test copy and load with the original game.
Re-enable the Mod only under the agreed test rule.
requiredEvidence: vanilla load after disabling the Mod
